SELECT min(date) AS ds_min, max(date) AS ds_max, count(*) AS rows
FROM store.daily_sales;

SELECT p.sku, p.name,
       COALESCE(SUM(ds.units_sold),0) AS units_june,
       COALESCE(SUM(ds.revenue_inr),0) AS revenue_june,
       COALESCE(SUM(ds.units_sold),0) * p.cost_inr AS cogs_june,
       COALESCE(SUM(ds.revenue_inr),0) - COALESCE(SUM(ds.units_sold),0) * p.cost_inr AS gross_margin_june
FROM store.products p
LEFT JOIN store.daily_sales ds ON ds.sku = p.sku AND ds.date >= '2026-06-01' AND ds.date < '2026-07-01'
GROUP BY p.sku, p.name, p.cost_inr
ORDER BY gross_margin_june;

SELECT
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(mdr_inr),0) FROM payments.upi_settlements WHERE settlement_date >= '2026-06-01' AND settlement_date < '2026-07-01') AS mdr_june,
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(w.units * p.cost_inr),0) FROM store.write_offs w JOIN store.products p ON p.sku = w.sku WHERE w.date >= '2026-06-01' AND w.date < '2026-07-01') AS writeoff_cost_june,
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(gross_inr),0) FROM payments.upi_settlements WHERE settlement_date >= '2026-06-01' AND settlement_date < '2026-07-01') AS upi_gross_june,
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(b.book_on_hand_close * p.cost_inr),0) FROM store.inventory_book b JOIN store.products p ON p.sku = b.sku WHERE b.date = (SELECT max(date) FROM store.inventory_book)) AS inventory_value_latest;

SELECT 'settlements' AS what, min(settlement_date)::text AS d1, max(settlement_date)::text AS d2, count(*)::text AS n, round(sum(gross_inr),2)::text AS gross

UNION ALL

UNION ALL
SELECT 'pos_lines', min(bill_ts)::text, max(bill_ts)::text, count(*)::text, round(sum(line_amount),2)::text

SELECT
  (SELECT round(COALESCE(SUM(amount_inr),0),2) FROM payments.pos_payments WHERE ts >= '2026-06-01' AND ts < '2026-07-01') AS pos_june,
  (SELECT round(COALESCE(SUM(amount_inr),0),2) FROM payments.psp_upi_report WHERE initiated_ts >= '2026-06-01' AND initiated_ts < '2026-07-01') AS psp_june,

SELECT unit_price,

**Q1 — Add/drop products.** June gross margin by SKU (revenue − units×cost) is positive for all 11 SKUs, from ₹3,054 (Sugar 1 kg) to ₹29,232 (Rice 5 kg). No SKU is loss-making, so nothing is indicated for dropping on profitability grounds; Sugar 1 kg is the weakest (2.5% of margin). There is no record of any products beyond these 11, so nothing can be said about additions. Verdict: proxy (June gross margin used as the stand-in for a range decision; no range/assortment records exist).

**Q2 — Supplier payment terms and working capital.** There is no suppliers table, no purchase invoices and no accounts-payable/receivable records anywhere in the three schemas, so payment terms have no record. Working capital cannot be computed; the only computable component is inventory at cost: ₹62,066.50 (book_on_hand_close × cost, 2026-06-28). Verdict: proxy (inventory value at cost as a partial stand-in; payment terms: no record).

**Q3 — Payment complaints in June 2026.** 26 rows in payments.customer_complaints with complaint_ts in June 2026 (23 "charged twice", 3 "debited but the till said failed" — all are payment complaints). Verdict: answer, 26.

**Q4 — Profitable in June 2026?** June revenue ₹1,243,937 (pos_lines, matches daily_sales), COGS ₹1,107,731.10 → gross margin ₹136,205.90 (~11%). June write-offs at cost ₹15,269.10; UPI MDR ₹0. No record holds rent, wages, utilities or any other operating cost, so net profit cannot be confirmed — but at gross level the store is profitable. Verdict: proxy (gross margin as stand-in for profit).

**Q5 — Empty shelf-audit rows in June 2026.** 3 rows with status='empty' (ATTA-WW-5KG ×2, SUGAR-1KG ×1) out of 88 audits in June. Verdict: answer, 3.

**Q6 — Products sold.** 11 distinct SKUs in pos_lines (same 11 as store.products and daily_sales). Verdict: answer, 11.

**Q7 — Cashier productivity.** No cashier, till-operator or operator-ID column exists in pos_lines, pos_payments or any other table. Verdict: no record.

**Q8 — Price elasticity of 5 kg atta.** ATTA-WW-5KG sold at exactly one price (₹265.00) on every line from 4 May to 28 Jun 2026 (products.price_inr also ₹265); no price change ever occurred, so elasticity cannot be estimated. Verdict: no record.

  FROM payments.pos_payments

  SELECT bill_id, sum(line_amount) AS bill_amt
  FROM store.pos_lines

  GROUP BY bill_id
)

  SELECT bill_id, count(*) AS n_appr, sum(amount_inr) - max(bill_amt) AS excess

    SELECT p.bill_id, p.amount_inr, l.bill_amt

          WHERE bill_ts >= '2026-06-01' AND bill_ts < '2026-07-01' GROUP BY bill_id) l
      ON l.bill_id = p.bill_id
    WHERE p.ts >= '2026-06-01' AND p.ts < '2026-07-01' AND p.till_status='approved'
